scope: Initial Apple Silicon macOS 15+ Cargo/npm CLI release, plus requested current native app and real Codex/Claude screenshots

checklist.criterion: First-release scope is Apple Silicon macOS CLI
checklist.evidence: First-release acceptance is the Apple Silicon CLI on macOS 15 or later; other desktop/CPU/OS distribution remains separate.

checklist.criterion: One product version owner
checklist.evidence: One owner remains workspace.package.version=0.1.0; generated manifests/lockfiles and version tests pass. CI tools also have shared canonical pins.

checklist.criterion: Audited candidate is identified and tree is clean
checklist.evidence: The selected package source is 1e99aba7b9e3d9f76c953ddf03041166f45aa599. Subsequent commits record evidence only; final tree status is retained separately.

checklist.criterion: Pre-release identity is reconciled before public release
checklist.evidence: Archived the obsolete September release as a draft under archive/unpublished-v0.1.0-20260909, preserving the original annotated tag object and both assets. v0.1.0 is available for the explicitly authorized initial release.

checklist.criterion: Requested registry names are currently unused
checklist.evidence: All 14 Cargo names and npm magistr returned 404 at 2026-10-20T03:38:58Z. Availability does not reserve names or prove publishing permission.

checklist.criterion: All internal dependencies can be published
checklist.evidence: Fourteen normalized archives have matching 0.1.0 registry requirements and no remaining internal path dependency; package licenses retained.

checklist.criterion: Required assets are in extracted packages
checklist.evidence: Hosted run 39364916005 installs the extracted normalized Cargo archives in release mode on macOS 15.7.9 arm64 against a checksum-verified vendored registry, with no checkout dependency; installed CLI smoke checks pass.

checklist.criterion: Cargo package source matches reviewed source
checklist.evidence: All 14 final hosted Cargo archives reproduce byte for byte from the reviewed source with Cargo 1.99.1. Archive inventories, source metadata and SHA-256 comparisons are retained.

checklist.criterion: Advertised Rust minimum builds the CLI
checklist.evidence: The patched graph passes cargo +1.95.0 check --locked for the CLI library and binary; this is minimum-toolchain typechecking, not its full test suite.

checklist.criterion: Internal publication order follows dependencies
checklist.evidence: Fourteen-package publication-order.txt is derived from the dependency closure.

checklist.criterion: First publication tolerates quotas and partial failure
checklist.evidence: Exact reviewed archives, topological order, API/index/checksum reconciliation,429 Retry-After/bounded waits, uncertain-effect receipts and safe resumption are implemented;29 tests pass.

checklist.criterion: Account email and a suitable token are ready
checklist.evidence: CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN is absent from cli-release; owner must verify account email and authorize creation of new crates.

checklist.criterion: Packed package contains the versioned native CLI
checklist.evidence: magistr@0.1.0, macOS arm64 restriction, direct native bin, no runtime JavaScript dependencies or install hooks.

checklist.criterion: Global installation needs no Rust, Bun or checkout
checklist.evidence: Hosted packed-artifact install passed in an isolated prefix with those tools absent from PATH.

checklist.criterion: npx works from a fresh cache
checklist.evidence: Loopback registry and fresh-cache test passed, including the generated version-pinned MCP configuration.

checklist.criterion: Stdio, exit codes, signals and worker startup survive installation
checklist.evidence: Actual packed binary checks passed; there is no wrapper process to lose native signals.

checklist.criterion: Package file inventory is intentional
checklist.evidence: The final hosted package contains 933 regular files, no symlinks or unexpected paths, and a mode-0755 binary. Compressed size is 33,077,883 bytes; unpacked size is 115,844,287 bytes.

checklist.criterion: Uninstall works
checklist.evidence: Packed npm uninstall and executable removal passed.

checklist.criterion: Publishing account and interactive 2FA are ready
checklist.evidence: npm whoami returned ENEEDAUTH. Owner must sign in and complete first-publication authentication.

checklist.criterion: Subsequent trusted publisher is configured
checklist.evidence: No package exists yet. Configure the exact repository/workflow/environment and allow-publish after first creation; verify current expiry rules.

checklist.criterion: Executable is arm64 and uses expected system libraries
checklist.evidence: The exact hosted npm binary is Mach-O arm64, links only system dylibs and passes strict ad-hoc signature verification. SHA-256: 8c3d78ae31a27482812f88523fb268512a5cdf1471e50a99422f4926ed479317.

checklist.criterion: Minimum operating-system claim is tested
checklist.evidence: The documented minimum is macOS 15. Hosted clean installation runs on macOS 15 arm64; the binary's lower Mach-O linking target is explicitly not certification of older macOS versions.

checklist.criterion: Browser-downloaded archive passes Gatekeeper
checklist.evidence: No Developer ID/notarization proof. Cargo/npm installation is proven; do not advertise a notarized direct download.

checklist.criterion: One public MCP connection owns workflow and workspace access
checklist.evidence: magistr mcp --dir is used by current integrations; workflow/project and workspace/working-copy ownership remain distinct internally.

checklist.criterion: All capabilities have catalog coverage
checklist.evidence: One typed catalog covers direct common tools plus discover/execute and advanced workspace/workflow operations; schema/handler coverage passed.

checklist.criterion: Composition keeps authorization and bounded execution
checklist.evidence: Native authorization, sandbox bounds, sequential mutation and stop-on-failure receipts pass. Fresh native-session testing also fixed host routing to the exact unified public catalog; governance restrictions retain precedence.

checklist.criterion: Edits are verified, journaled and reject stale requests
checklist.evidence: Source/hash checks, confirmation behavior and session-scoped undo are covered in retained tests.

checklist.criterion: Concurrent agents and worktrees keep correct owners
checklist.evidence: Simultaneous clients, separate worktrees and owner restart passed in the eight process scenarios.

checklist.criterion: Cancellation and partial execution are recoverable
checklist.evidence: Cancellation, stale confirmations and partial failure tests passed; completed effects remain visible without automatic replay.

checklist.criterion: Response failures and truncation are explicit
checklist.evidence: Typed envelope/catalog checks passed; discovery needs no client-specific extension.

checklist.criterion: Current fixtures use current state names
checklist.evidence: All four tas-data fixture references now use workflow-state. Current source ownership/architecture gates pass; historical attribution and audit evidence remain intact.

checklist.criterion: Setup detects the project and proposes changes
checklist.evidence: Guided interview and administrative plan service are present; configuration and verification commands are reviewed before application.

checklist.criterion: Only selected integrations are generated
checklist.evidence: Codex, Claude Code and portable setup are supported; selected-agent and multi-agent process cases passed.

checklist.criterion: Repeated setup preserves custom settings and other servers
checklist.evidence: Customized-config, repeated setup, paths with spaces, repair and removal cases passed.

checklist.criterion: Unavailable clients produce actionable diagnostics
checklist.evidence: Unavailable-agent diagnostics and doctor behavior pass in the eight onboarding process scenarios.

checklist.criterion: Setup finishes with a real connection and read-only context
checklist.evidence: Protocol handshake/context checks passed; setup suggests planning and does not start implementation.

checklist.criterion: MCP startup does not automatically repair project files
checklist.evidence: Repair belongs to explicit setup/repair through the administrative change service.

checklist.criterion: Upgrade, repair and removal are documented
checklist.evidence: Current release procedure documents ownership-preserving repair/removal and reopening installed clients.

checklist.criterion: Interactive terminal onboarding is exercised
checklist.evidence: Eight onboarding process cases now include real background PTY customization, proposal-before-write, acceptance and cancellation with no file changes. No foreground or human usability walkthrough is claimed.

checklist.criterion: Codex and Claude Code were exercised on realistic workflows
checklist.evidence: Codex 0.163.0 and Claude Code 2.1.304 each completed implementation and fresh-session resumption against the exact final hosted npm binary. Independent state/source checks pass for safe edits, plans, feedback, decisions, roadmap, recorded verification and completion. One Claude read-only argument error was explicitly rejected and recovered; no automatic replay occurred.

checklist.criterion: Efficiency claims reflect measured evidence
checklist.evidence: Small comparisons record success/calls/context; Claude unified timing was worse. No broad performance or reliability claim is justified.

checklist.criterion: Exact candidate passes full Rust checks
checklist.evidence: Final source 1e99aba7 passes all-targets check, formatting, Clippy and 8,069 workspace tests in hosted run 39364882173; 18 opt-in cases are explicitly skipped.

checklist.criterion: Protocol and onboarding processes pass on release packaging
checklist.evidence: Final packaging run 39364916005 passes all eight unified MCP process scenarios and all eight onboarding scenarios, including the interactive PTY interview and cancellation.

checklist.criterion: Release does not wait for Windows Rust builds
checklist.evidence: Every Rust CI job now targets macOS, including the manual desktop workflow. Remaining Windows/Linux adapter checks execute JavaScript only and have a 10-minute bound; public HTTP checks use a 5-minute job.

checklist.criterion: CI duration is bounded and measured
checklist.evidence: Final Rust/website job took 1,000 seconds (16m40s), within its 30-minute bound. Packaging took 836 seconds; independent desktop jobs took 483 and 525 seconds, and security took 120 seconds. Jobs ran concurrently.

checklist.criterion: Skipped live scenarios are accounted for
checklist.evidence: The final hosted skip inventory is retained separately. Opt-in local Codex and Claude transport checks were also run; optional cloud/tracker/keychain and reference scenarios are not covered by the full-suite pass.

checklist.criterion: Reviewed artifacts are tied to checks and checksums
checklist.evidence: Publication selector requires the intended successful package run/source and matching installation receipts; source archive reproduction passed.

checklist.criterion: Artifacts are retained long enough for review
checklist.evidence: Verified hosted artifact 12238999976 is retained until 2027-01-18T03:33:25Z; local ZIP and unpacked copies plus tracked inventories/receipts are retained. Security approval expires after 24 hours and requires a fresh qualification if delayed.

checklist.criterion: Enabled native dependencies have no unresolved applicable advisories
checklist.evidence: Final-source target-aware scanning reports zero findings across 492 enabled native CLI packages, including advisory warnings; no dependency exception is configured.

checklist.criterion: Sandbox runtime is on an acceptable security baseline
checklist.evidence: Wasmtime 48.0.7 and the grammar component's C API 36.0.19 clear the current runtime findings. Affected sandbox and language-pack tests pass.

checklist.criterion: Website dependencies have a reviewed security baseline
checklist.evidence: Astro 7.4.1, MDX 8.1.0 and Sharp 0.35.5 replace the vulnerable website dependency chain. Current npm audit reports zero findings.

checklist.criterion: Release-script JavaScript dependencies pass current audit
checklist.evidence: The release tooling, including pinned Wrangler 4.151.2, has zero current npm audit findings.

checklist.criterion: Git-history secret matches are reviewed
checklist.evidence: Full-history Gitleaks 8.30.1 reports only 21 exact reviewed synthetic-fixture fingerprints. No broad file exclusions or inline suppression is accepted.

checklist.criterion: Embedded JavaScript engine has provenance
checklist.evidence: QuickJS-ng 0.16.2 WASI hash matches the official release asset; reviewed upstream advisories do not establish an unfixed matching issue.

checklist.criterion: Prebuilt embedded engine is reproducible from source
checklist.evidence: Upstream asset/source/license provenance is retained; original toolchain inputs are insufficient for an independent byte-for-byte rebuild.

checklist.criterion: Security checks are enforced before publication
checklist.evidence: Push/PR security and artifact-bound package scans are enforced. Publication requires successful matching source runs and a clean receipt bound to every archive, less than 24 hours old.

checklist.criterion: Action and compiler inputs are immutable
checklist.evidence: External workflow/composite actions use full commit SHAs. Rust 1.99.1, Node 24.22.0, Python 3.14.8, Nextest 0.9.130 and scanners have reviewed canonical pins; the hosted arm64 jobs use them.

checklist.criterion: Main and release environment have appropriate protection
checklist.evidence: Main has strict Rust/website and security requirements bound to GitHub Actions, conversation resolution, administrator enforcement, and no force pushes/deletions. The cli-release environment accepts only main. Required environment reviewers are unavailable on the current private account plan; that remaining setting follows the owner's visibility/plan decision. Final enforcement is checked again after the evidence push.

checklist.criterion: Package provenance is accurately described
checklist.evidence: Checksums/source receipts exist. First interactive npm upload has no automatic OIDC provenance; later public-repository trusted uploads can have it.

checklist.criterion: Package license notices match their inventory
checklist.evidence: The final native notice inventory contains 534 dependency records and 925 notice hashes, including nested native-library attribution. Exact packed notice bytes are checked independently; this is a technical inventory review.

checklist.criterion: Data and permission behavior is fully observed
checklist.evidence: Code defaults telemetry consent off and requires an endpoint; local records/provider permissions are documented. No packet-capture audit of every optional integration was performed.

checklist.criterion: Public website is reachable
checklist.evidence: The production homepage and installation guide respond successfully at magistr.dev.

checklist.criterion: Deployed instructions match current setup
checklist.evidence: Deployed current selected-agent setup, read-only connection check, plan-first boundary, doctor, repair, upgrade and removal instructions; registry packages are truthfully marked unpublished.

checklist.criterion: Repository and support links are public
checklist.evidence: Repository/releases/issues/security URLs return anonymous 404 while repository is private. Owner visibility decision is outstanding.

checklist.criterion: Private vulnerability reporting works
checklist.evidence: Current API/page check could not establish a usable route. Enable and verify private reporting or document a concrete private contact.

checklist.criterion: Launch checks verify deployed content and required links
checklist.evidence: Semantic HTTP/content checks now run the website stage on every push/PR, publication prerequisites before uploads, and registry/full-release checks on manual/tag release runs. No continue-on-error bypass.

checklist.criterion: Visual evidence describes what is actually deployed
checklist.evidence: Production deployment 551dda39-03b8-4b26-bebe-6c4e26e046de serves the reviewed source. All 39 current versioned resources match; 12 fresh production gallery frames were opened and reviewed, alongside 12 corrected local frames and four selected real product/client images.

checklist.criterion: Owner approves exact corrected artifacts and public launch
checklist.evidence: Owner approval is still required for version 0.1.0 from source 1e99aba7b9e3d9f76c953ddf03041166f45aa599 and selected CLI packages run 39364916005. No registry upload or new public tag has occurred.

checklist.criterion: Cargo installs successfully from the real registry
checklist.evidence: Run after publication using an isolated Cargo home/root and --locked; unpublished names cannot be installed from crates.io now.

checklist.criterion: npm global and npx install successfully from the real registry
checklist.evidence: After publication, verify integrity and exact version with fresh cache/prefix and a disposable project.

checklist.criterion: Published archives match reviewed hashes and metadata
checklist.evidence: After upload, fetch registry archives and compare all 14 Cargo checksums, npm integrity/version/bin metadata and release assets.

checklist.criterion: Support and correction procedure is ready for a bad upload
checklist.evidence: Exact-artifact partial-upload recovery, uncertain-effect handling and immutable bad-version correction/yank/deprecation procedures are documented and covered by controlled-registry tests.

checklist.criterion: Public release is explicitly declared
checklist.evidence: Declare public release only after authorized uploads, real registry install/hash checks and deployed installation/support routes pass. The archived September draft is not a public-release declaration.

remainingOwnerActions.action: Verify the crates.io account email; create a token permitted to create all fourteen new crates and add CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN to the cli-release GitHub environment using the masked prompt.
Sign in to npm on this Mac, enable account 2FA and complete interactive browser authentication.
Approve making AlrikOlson/magistr public. Then enable and verify private vulnerability reporting and supported release-environment review restrictions.

Explicitly authorize publication of version 0.1.0 from CLI packages run 39364916005, source 1e99aba7b9e3d9f76c953ddf03041166f45aa599, after reviewing its exact checksums. Refresh expired security qualification before uploading.

After the first npm package exists, configure its exact GitHub trusted publisher with interactive 2FA. The next successful trusted publication must occur within two days of creating the configuration; otherwise recreate it when needed.

postPublicationChecks: Fetch all registry archives and compare exact checksums and metadata.
Run fresh real-registry Cargo, npm global and npx installations.
Update and verify published installation/support routes.
Create the approved public tag/release and declare release only after those checks pass.

worktree.policy: Evidence and release documentation commits after the selected source do not alter product, build, package or workflow inputs. Final Git cleanliness and restored administrator enforcement are recorded by native launch-administration checks after the final evidence push.
